title: Raw Whisper text: the phone's upload was slow; the page now sends half the bytes

owner_note.text: From 18:12 the phone's uplink got about 14 times slower per byte. Whisper itself was as fast as before. The page now sends 8-bit audio (same text, half the bytes), and a guess still uploading no longer holds up the final. Guess text is now clearly readable and written text is full strength in V1, V2 and V3. The alternative is Opus audio (a tenth of the bytes), but it needs ffmpeg on the PC; it's written up in the doc.
